body.spec_md: qualifier/Q2/paid-route.ts exports createPaidRoute({price, payTo, network, facilitator}) -> (request: Request) => Promise<Response>, with the x402 contract of bundle OP6 (402 with payment requirements, then verify, settle, 200 with X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE).

body.notes: Q2: createPaidRoute returns a Request handler that answers 402 with the x402 requirements while unpaid, then calls facilitator.verify, then facilitator.settle, and answers 200 with X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE only after a settlement that reports success. A failed verification is never settled and a settlement reporting success:false is a 402 even when it carries a transaction id. Ten tests named A4. Every test name carries its acceptance item, and the suite runs with no install on Node 24.

note: Captured with one real paid call from the agent's own wallet. The payTo is the same fleet wallet, so the 0.005 USDC transfer is to itself (net zero); the point is that the endpoint answered after a verified and settled x402 payment.
